title: Share & Import Agents
overview: Share the agents you build and import agents your teammates send you — all in a couple of clicks.

steps.text: Firstly, click the Agents tab to view and manage your agents.
Choose an agent from your library that you want to share, then click the copy link button to copy its URL.
After that, enter your colleague's email address to send them a sharing invite.
Then, click the Send invite button to share this agent with the recipient.
Following this, click the Republish button to save and publish your sharing changes.
On the receiving end: open the email with the shared agent link and click Add to my account to import it.
After that, click the Accept & copy agent button to add the Souvenir Scout agent.
Go to your Agents page and click Use in chat to start using the agent in the chatspace.
As the final step, click the message input field to type your message to the Souvenir Scout agent.
